description: Na₂VSiCO₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/m space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.53 Å. V is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted VO₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.11 Å. Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 36-46°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.67 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are a spread of C-O bond distances ranging from 1.25-1.32 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted tetrahedral geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent Na, one V, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one V and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one V, and one Si atom.
